name: open-claude-design
title_zh: 一个把 claude.ai/design 项目搬进本
tagline_zh: 你发来 claude.ai/design 链接或 .dc.html 文件，它才现身接管项目、文件。
tagline_en: Wakes only for claude.ai/design URLs or .dc.html files, then takes over projects, files, design systems, and.
desc_en: Access the Anthropic product named Claude Design when the request contains that exact name, a claude.ai/design URL, or a .dc.html file. Use for its projects, files, design systems, previews, conversations, comments, sharing, and code-to-design or design-to-code synchronization; otherwise stay inactive.
why_zh: 它把 Anthropic 官方设计产品收编进你的工作流，靠精确匹配触发，不靠模糊意图猜。
why_en: It folds Anthropic's official design product into your workflow via exact-match triggers, not fuzzy intent—so it never butts.
limit_zh: 只认三种触发：请求里含 Claude Design 全名、claude.ai/design 链接。
limit_en: Triggers only on exact name 'Claude Design', claude.ai/design URLs, or .dc.html files. Otherwise inert. It gates and syncs—it does not generate.
title_en: Official gateway to pull claude.ai/design projects into.
